Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The Paris Cup will be held this year on March 4. As every year, the trophy will be given to the winner after the 3 rounds and the final.

Location: Troll2Jeux, 15-17 Pl. d'Aligre, 75012 Paris
Timetable :
10:00 am: Beginning of the registrations
10:30 am: End of registration
10:40-12:40: Round 1
12:40-13:30 : LUNCH BREAK
13:40 - 15:40: Round 2
15:45-17:45: Round 3
17:55-19:55 : Final

Admission fee : 10€ +3€ for VEKN Paris membership for the year 2023
As usual, there will be prizes for everyone.

IMPORTANT : The event will be limited to 25 places.

www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/10587

Prince of Paris, France
